orig.il: So am I made to possess
unto the dawning of the day

orig.gloss: and/ they have come to an end

orig.il: him? and that thou shouldest set
from me, nor let me alone
against thee, so that I am a burden
And why dost thou not pardon

orig.gloss: and/ you will look for/ me
orig.il: and thou shalt seek me in the morning
